disposition_reason: Original ICP-OES measurements of eight elements in wheat grain and Sangak and Lavash bread flours from 10 Iranian factories; numbers are printed only as extreme averages in the text and per-element maxima in Table 3, with the main results in a bar chart.
disposition_locator: Section 3.1 text, Table 3 (p. 7); Figure 1 not read

study.design: Factory sampling of wheat grain and milled bread flours with probabilistic risk assessment
study.market: Collected at 10 flour factories (A-J) in different areas of Iran
study.method: Acid digestion of 5 g homogenized sample in Teflon vessel; ICP-OES; triplicate measurements
study.qa: Spiked blank samples at 100, 500 and 1000 ppm in triplicate; recoveries summarized as acceptable (values not printed); RSD < 20%

unresolved: Per-sample-type and per-factory means appear only in Figure 1 (bar chart); not read.

Sample counts per type are not given beyond n = 270 in total.

Recovery values said to be in Table 1 are not printed there.
